caption: PID 1201 hashes to bucket 177 by 1201 mod 512. On exit() with no wait(), mm and files are freed but TASK_ZOMBIE keeps its task_struct, PID and exit status until wait() releases it.

spec.title: PID 1201 → bucket 177 (B = 512)
spec.aria: A flow diagram: PID 1201 hashes by mod 512 to bucket 177, whose chain reaches a task_struct in state TASK_RUNNING with mm and files set; exit() frees mm and files but leaves TASK_ZOMBIE, which keeps its task_struct, PID and exit status until wait() releases it.
